oṃ śrī sundaragaṇapataye namaḥ {parārthapujāvidhiḥ} (ṛE-30482)
(F1a is mentioning the text name ṁ the writer name ) [nityapūjāvidhi araśūrī tyāgarāyaguru sva hastalukhitam]|(F1b is blank) parārthapūjāvidhi(dhiḥ) (F1a 1st line) kṣetrapālasannidhau upāgamyā(mya) dvārapūjāṃ vidhāya snānādyabhiṣekārcananaivedyadhūpadīpārghyaṃ (2nd line) datvā prārthayet svāminsarvajanānbhūmau rakṣārdhaṃ kṣetrapākalam| śivapūjāvidhānāṅgamudrādaṇḍaṃ (3rd line) pradehi me| ityaṅkuśamudrādi(dida)ṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā śayanālayadvāramupāgamya śivaśakti(4th line) nayanonmīlanārthaṃ dvi(dvā)rapārśve rudragaṇikāgītavādyaṃ vācayitvā dvārapūjanena (5th line) kavāṭodghāṭanaṃ kṛtvā vighnatrayaṃ nivāryantaḥ praviśya arghyodakena astreṇa oṃ ca avṛta(6th line) tirodhānapaṭaṃ samprokṣya varmaṇābhyarcya mañcordhve nikṣipya astreṇa mūrtiṃ saṃprokṣya nirmālyaṃ visṛjya (7th line) pādahastaśudhyartham astreṇa jalaṃ datvā snānārthaṃ mūlena arghyodakena saṃprokṣya (F1b, 1st line) anyatvastragandhamālyādibhiralakṛ(ṅkṛ)tya mūlabrahmāṅgamantraiḥ sampūjya naivedyadhūpadīpārdhyaṃ datvā śaktiṃ vinā devaṃ (2nd line) śibikām aropya sarvādyo(sarva vādyo)pacāraparijanaiśca liṅgasannidhimupāgamya tanmūrdhiṃ(rdhnīṃ) puṣpeṇodbhavamudrayā (3rd line) liṅge saṃyojya yathāsthāne mūrtiṃ saṃsthāpya pūjārthaṃ snapanaṃ kūrmāsanopari sthitvā (4th line) snānaśuddhim ācaret arghyodakena bhūmiṃ samprokṣya astreṇa caturaśraṃ kṛtvā (5th line) bhūmidevyāsanādibhiḥ āvāhanaṃ vidhāya dhyānaṃ (-) dvibhujāñca dvinetrāñca karaṇḍamakuṭānvitām|(6th line) varābhayakarāṃ devīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām|| iti dhyātvā hṛdayā(ya)astreṇasaṃpūjya naivedyārghyaṃ datvā (7th line) evaṃ sthalaśuddhiḥ| śaṅkhārghya(-)ācamanīya(-)pādyapātra(-)puṣpānyapātrāṇi astreṇa prakṣālya (F2a 1st line) hṛdayena sthāpya vilokya amṛtīkṛtya vardhanyāṃ śaṅkhapātre mūlena jalamāpūrya śivamantreṇa vardhanīṃ (2nd line) saṃpūjya brahmāgai(ṅgai)rabhyarcya abhimantrya adho(dhaḥ) astramantramabhyarcya liṅgapadmamudrāṃ pradarśya śaṅkhodakasya (3rd line) pañcaśuddhiṃ vidhāya mūlenābhyarcya ekādaśavāraṃ daśabījenābhimaṃtryi(trya) adho(dhaḥ) astramahāmudrāṃ pradarśya dhūpadīpaṃ datvā (4th line) tajjalena dravyāṇi saṃprokṣya viśeṣārghyapātrapādyācamanīya(ya)pātrāṇi sādhayet| teṣu (5th line) uktadravyāṇi nikṣipya arghyodakaṃ astrabrahmāgai(ṅgai)rabhyarcya abhimantrya pādyapātraṃ hṛdayenābhyarcya praṇavena (6th line) saptadhā abhimantrya ācamanīya(ya)pātraṃ daśabījenābhimantrya tatsaṅkhyābhimantrya dhenvādipañcamudrāṃ pradarśya dhupadīpaṃ (7th line) datvā dravyaśuddhiḥ| śivahastabhāvanārthaṃ de(da)kṣiṇakaratale mūlena(-)gandhapuṣpākṣatānvidhāya vāmahastena (F2b 1st line) gandhapuṣpākṣatān vidhāya vāmahastena nirīkṣaṇādyamṛtīkaraṇāntaṃ kṛtvā dharmādyāsanamūrtimabhyarcya (2nd line) mūlabrahmāṅgāni vinyasya jyotīrūpaṃ dhyātvā śivamantreṇa śirasi nni(ni)kṣipya (3rd line) hastadvayaṃ pra(prā)sādena divyadṛṣṭyā vilokya śivahastaṃ bhāvayet pañca (.......)paścimabhāge śālibhiḥ|(4th line) hastamātraṃ catu (....)(rastraṃ) vidhāya adhītaveda (....) madhye ravisaṅkhyakṛtāsu rekhakoṣṭāni tatva(5th line) samavīthiṣu pañcakeṣu tatrādyavidhimapahāya dvitīya(ya)paṅktiṃ ssa(sa)mmājya(rjya) pūrvamapi ca uktarānandasaṅkhyā evaṃ (6th line) ullikhya madhyapade śivatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| pūrve sadāśivatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| de(da)kṣiṇe vidyātatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| (7th line) uttare puruṣatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| paścime kālatatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| (F3a 1st line) āgneyām īśvaratatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| naiṛte pā(pāda)tatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| vāyavye niyatitatvakoṣṭhā namaḥ|(2nd line) aiśānyāṃ prakṛtitatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| evaṃ koṣṭhānyabhyarcya dhūpadīpākhyaṃ datvā (3rd line) navapātrāṇyastreṇāvṛtya hṛdayena prakṣālya astreṇa samprokṣyā vimūṇā(varmaṇā) dhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā (4th line) koṣṭhamadhye pātrāṇi samsthāpya madhye oṃ hāṃ supratiṣṭhitapātrāya namaḥ| pūrve oṃ hāṃ (5th line) suśāntapātrāya namaḥ| de(da)kṣiṇe tejovat pātrāya namaḥ uttare ratnodakapātrāya namaḥ paścime amṛtātmakapātrāya namaḥ (6th line)
aiśānyāṃ avyaktapātrāya namaḥ| āgneyādivāyavyāntam amṛtātmakapātrāya namaḥ iti sampūjya (7th line) gandhādibhiralakṛtya madhyapātrasya (,,,)dhyāsyadeśeṣu brahmaviṣṇurudramūrtīn saṃpūjya (F3b 1st line) tasya pūrvādi uttarāntaṃ gaṇapatiṣaṇmukhanabhimahākālān sampūjya vidikṣu caturvedān abhyarcya dhūpadīpārghyaṃ (2nd line) datvā āpyāyasvetimantreṇa madhyamapātre kṣiramāpūrya dadhikrāviṇnotivai dadhidakṣiṇe (3rd line) śukramasītighṛtaṃ uttare sāvitrāgomūtraṃ paścime gandhadvāreti gomayaṃ aiśānyāṃ devasyatveti kuśodakaṃ (4th line) āgneyyādi vāyavyantam astreṇa taila(-)piṣṭāmalaka(-)rajanīdravyāṇi samsthāpya (5th line)
kūrcapallavaratna nālīkerāṇi vinyasya puṇyāhajalena samprokṣya kṣīrādikuśodakam (6th line) īśānassarvavidyānāmiti mantreṇa pañcapātreṣu pañcacatustrīṇiyugmekamantrābhimantryāvāhya yathoktamudrāṃ (7th line) pradarśya naivedyadhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā anyapātrāṇi ṣaḍaṅgenābhyarcya mahāmudrāṃ pradarśya (F4a 1st line)
mūlabrahmāṅgavyāhṛtiṃ daśabījaisaṃkṣīrādi kuśodakāntaṃ tailādirajanyāntaṃ bhikramamantreṇābhimantrya (2nd line) pūrvādipañcapātrasthitadravyapātrakramaṃ madhyapātre samyojya mūlena aṣṭhottaraśataṃ japtvā digīśvara(3rd line) dhanāvakunṭhanau vidhāya mānastoketanayeti mantreṇa trivāranimudhya vāmade(da)kṣiṇahastābhyāṃ (4th line)
nādoccāraṇena nāsāgramudhra(ddhṛ)tya mūlamantreṇa sthāpyā(pya) arcayediti pañcagavyam| (5th line) atha pañcāmṛtaṃ tat paścimabhāge śālibhistaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā madhye navapadaṃ vidhāya āgneyyādicatuṣpadān yajet (6th line) maghyapade oṃ hāṃ prathivītatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| pūrve oṃ hāṃ aptatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| dakṣiṇe (F4b 1st line)
oṃ hāṃ vahnitatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| paścime oṃ hāṃ vāyutatvakoṣṭhāya namaḥ| uttare oṃ hāṃ vyomatatva(2nd line) koṣṭhāya namaḥ| ityabhyarcya pātrāṇi tantunāveṣṭhya astreṇa prakṣālya hṛdayena dhūpadīpaṃ datvā (3rd line) pātrāṇi koṣṭheṣu vidhāya madhye oṃ hāṃ gandhatatvapātrāya namaḥ| pūrve oṃ hāṃ (4th line) rasatatvapātrāya namaḥ| yāmye rūpatatvapātrāya namaḥ| paścime sparśatatvapātrāya namaḥ| uttare (5th line) śabdatatvapātrāya namaḥ| iti sampūjya madhye payaḥ, pūrve phalaṃ, yāmye madhu, sarpa vā pradīcyāṃ (6th line) śakrāgulaṃha, uttare ikṣusāraṃ vā nālikerasalilaṃ vā brahmamantraissampūjya pūrvavat (7th line) brahmāge(ṅge)nābhimantrya āvāhya pañcamudrānpradarśya dhūpadīpārghyaṃdatvā pūrvādicaturdikṣu pātrastadṛvyaṇi (F5a 1st line) madhyamapātre samyojya mūlenābhimantrya digbandhanāvakunṭhanaṃ vidhāya vaidī(di)kabrahmāṅgamantrābhyām (2nd line) abhimantrya(ntryā)ditipañcāmṛtam| snapanaṃ tat paścimabhāge droṇatraya(-)vrīhi(-)taṇḍuladhānyopari (3rd line) pañcatālamātraṃ caturaśraṃ padam ālikhya tadupari padmāsanam abhyarcya navakumbhān vardhanīṃ (4th line) sūtreṇāveṣṭhya hṛdayena prakṣālya astreṇa dhūpadīpaṃ datvā udakenāpūryāsugandhadravya(5th line) ratnakūrcaplavanālikeraphalakusumadāmādibhiḥ gandhākṣatavastreṇa alaṅkṛtya astreṇa (6th line) padmoparisamsthāpya abhyarcayet madhye śivāsanamūrtiṃ sampūjya āvāhanasthāpanādi (7th line) pañcamudrāṃ pradarśya vardhanyāṃ manonmanimantreṇāvāhya sthāpanādi padmayonimahāmudrāñca (F5b 1st line) pradarśya pūrvādidikṣu ananteśādiśikhaṇḍyāntam abhyarcya naivedya dhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā mātṛkādi(2nd line) kalābhaṅgīṃ vinyasya iti snapanam| atha saurapūjā(-) atha saurapūjā indrāgniyormadhye īśe vā sūryam abhyarcayet (3rd line) sūryāgre uttarābhimukho praṇavenārghyaṃ samsthāpya dvāramastreṇa samprokṣya dvāradakṣiṇavāmapārśvayoḥ| (4th line) daṇḍine namaḥ oṃ hāṃ piṅgalāya namaḥ gaṇapataye namaḥ gurubhyo namaḥ antaṅgatvā āsane oṃ hāṃ prabhūtāsanāya namaḥ(5th line)
garbhāvaraṇe naiṛtyādi īśānāntaṃ vimalāya namaḥ sārāya namaḥ ārādhyāya namaḥ paramasukhāya namaḥ|(6th line) padmāya namaḥ iti padmamudrāṃ pradarśya tasya mukhāgrādyaṣṭadikṣu oṃ rāṃ dīptāyai namaḥ oṃ rīṃ sūkṣmāyai namaḥ oṃ (7th line) ruṃ jayāyai namaḥ oṃ rūṃ bhadrāyai namaḥ| oṃ reṃ vibhūtyai namaḥ| oṃ raiṃ vimalāyai namaḥ oṃ roṃ amokhā(ghā)yai namaḥ|(F6a 1st line)
oṃ rauṃ vidyutāyai namaḥ| karṇikāyāmīśāne oṃ raḥ sarvatomukhyai namaḥ| vispuramudrāṃ (2nd line) darśayitvā oṃ hāṃ arkāsanāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ arkamūrtaye namaḥ| oṃ khaṃ khaṣolkāya sūryamūrtaye namaḥ|(3rd line) oṃ hāṃ bhānunetrābhyāṃ namaḥ| oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ saha śivasūryāya namaḥ| iti mantreṇāvāhya sthāpanādi pañcamudrāṃ (4th line) pradarśya dhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā dhyānam ādityaṃ sarvakartāraṃ kalādvidaśa samyutam| padmahastadvayaṃ (*)vande sarvalokaikasākṣiṇam|| iti (*)(5th line)
dhyātvā gāyatrīṃ vinyasya aṅgāni sampūjya bimbajalenābhyarcya (6th line) sampūjya triti(tṛtī)yāvaraṇe daśalokapālān sampūjya naivedyadhūpadīpārghyaṃ datvā vāmato (7th line) tejaścanḍeśvarāya namaḥ| iti sampūjya punarmūlena mūrti(rtiṃ) hṛdayena vinyasya namaskāraṃ vidhāya|(F6b 1st line) [iti sūryapūjāvidhi(dhiḥ) samāptaḥ]| atha gaṇeśapūjā ḥ(-) gaṇeśāgramanṭape saumyāsyopaviśya prāṇāyāmādi(2nd line) sakalīkṛtyācamya vyāpaka(kaṃ) nyaset oṃ gaṃ sarveśvarāya namaḥ iti śirasi oṃ giṃ vighnahantre namaḥ iti netre oṃ guṃ (3rd line) gajamukhāya namaḥ kaṭyāṃ oṃ gaiṃ ākhuvāhanāya namaḥ iti ūrvoḥ oṃ gauṃ vighneśvarāya namaḥ| jānvo(nvoḥ) oṃ gaṃ gaṇeśvarāya namaḥ (4th line) iti pādayoḥ pañcaśśi(śi)romukhavakṣaguhyajānupādeṣu gaṇānāṃtveti pañcamantraiḥ sārdhaṃ vinyasya (5th line) ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāyādviramantrau samprokṣya ūrdhve gaṇapatisarasvatimahālakṣmīṃ sampūjya pārśvayoḥ (6th line) bhuvaṅgapataṅgakūśmāṇḍakuṃbhodarān namontaṃ sampūjya mūlena citomaṇipīṭhe padmāsane (7th line) samabhyarcya gāmityādibījasya dvārapālān supūjya agre mahāsūramūṣikamabhyayarcya upacāraṃ vidhāya antargatvā (8th line) naiṛtyādīśānāntaṃ vā sutadevasarasvatīlakṣmīvijayā iti pāśāṅkuśatrikhaṇḍayoni(-)mahā(F7a 1st line) mudrānnamaskāramudrāṃ pradarśya dhyānaṃ(-) gajānanaṃ triṇetrañca kuṅkumābhaṃ caturbhujam| (2nd line) pāśadantaṃ ca savye tu vāme tvaṃ kuśalaḍḍukau|| iti dhyātvā abhyaṅgādi snapanodakadravyodakena abhiṣicya (3rd line) vasra(strā)dibhiralaṅkṛtya pūrvavat sampūjya pārśvayoḥ siddhalakṣmīvallabhābhyāṃ namaḥ ityabhyarcya dvitīyāvaraṇe (4th line) gaṇeśāṣṭamūrtīn japet | yogaje(-) vighneśvaramahākhaṇḍaṃ gajavaktraṃ mahodakam| ekadantaṃ (5th line) mahākāyaṃ vināyakagaṇādhipam| iti sampūjya triti(tṛtī)yāvaraṇe| cintyatantre ḥ(-) bālo bhaktaśca śaktisarvārthasiddhidaḥ|(6th line)
piṅgalocciṣṭaraktaśca kṣipro heramba eva ca || lakṣmī vijayanṛttastu ūrdhvāmaha(hā)gaṇastathā| (7th line)
haridraṣoḍaśā jñeyāḥ stri(tṛ)tīyāḥ prati pūjayet || caturthāvaraṇe āgneyātipantānatarumūlena sarasvatīsametāya (8th line) brahmaṇe namaḥ| naiṛtyāṃ mandāratarumūle lakṣmīsametāya viṣṇave namaḥ vāyavyāṃ kalpatarumūle bhavānī(F7b 1st line) sametāya maheśvarāya namaḥ aiśānyāṃ candanatarumūle ratyāṃ sametāya kāmadevāya namaḥ| pañcamāvaraṇe indrādi(2nd line) lokapālān sampūjya nālikerādi nānāvidhānne modakalaḍḍukādi naivedyadhūpadīpārghyaṃ (3rd line) datvā dvārapālādimūṣiko'ṣṭadikṣu devatābaliṃ nikṣipya balipīṭhe sarvavighnagaṇarūpāya (4th line) namaḥ ityabhyarcya oṃ hāṃ sarvavidhnagaṇebhyasvāheti baliṃ datvā agre nirodhārghyaṃ (5th line) prakṣipya sarvopacārānvidhāya iti vighneśvarapūjā||(F8a 1st line) svāmi pūjai(jā) ḥ(-) atha devadvāramupāgamya de(da)kṣiṇapārśve nālikerādyupacāraiḥ sampūjya arghyodakena dvāramastreṇa samprokṣya (2nd line) abhiṣicya dakṣiṇottaramadhyeṣu gaṇapatisarasvatimahālakṣmīm abhyarcya madhye dakṣiṇapārśve (....)ne namaḥ (3rd line) gaṅgāya namaḥ uttarapārśve mahākālāya namaḥ yamunāya namaḥ atha ūrdhvaśilayoḥ bhuvaṅgapataṅgābhyāṃ namaḥ| dakṣiṇa(4th line) vāmastambhayoḥ| (utkāra)patākābhyāṃ namaḥ| kavāṭayoḥ vimalāya namaḥ subāhuve namaḥ| paṭṭikāyāṃ (5th line) skandāya namaḥ| valayoḥ candrasūryābhyāṃ namaḥ| suṣire navaśaktiṃ sampūjya agre astrāya namaḥ dakṣiṇabhittipārśve (6th line) astrāya dvārapālāya namaḥ| daṇḍine namaḥ| aruṇakiraṇarūpaṃ ca asyābhimantriṇetraṃ jaṭamṛgavadanordhvaṃ (7th line) nyasya pādordhvavaktraṃ vikasitakarayugmaṃ smayaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ jayamaṇimālikāḍyāṃ ḍiṇḍirūpaṃ bhajāmi (F8b 1st line) iti dhyātvā uttarapārśve astrāya dvārapālāya namaḥ| muṇḍine namaḥ| analatanunibhāṅgaṃ vaktrabhīmaṃ jaṭorddham(rdhvam)| varahasita(*)karaṇḍaṃ vāstumudrāgrahastam|| (*)(2nd line) kaṭitaṭibandhapāśaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ nāgabhūṣam| munisuranarasevyaṃ muṇḍirūpaṃ bhajāmi|| iti (3rd line) dhyātvā arghyaṃ datvā agre vṛṣabheśvarāya namaḥ| dhyānam ḥ(-) rajatanibhaśarīraṃ vedapādaṃ mukhorghvam| aruṇamuditaśṛṅgaṃ (*)agnivarṇaṃ triṇetram||(*)(4th line) gaṇamaṇimālikābhyāṃ kiṅkiṇīdāmabhūṣam| haritanudharmarūpam ādidevaṃ vṛṣeśam||(5th line) iti dhyātvā mūlenābhyarcya yasya śṛṅgasya vṛṣabheti mantreṇa avāhya gāyatrīṃ vinyasya
